description: Let \(T,S\) be sentence theories in countable languages. If a model of \(S\) exists whenever a model of \(T\) is given, then external syntactic consistency of \(T\) implies external syntactic consistency of \(S\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.LargerModels.relative_consistency.{u, v, u_1, u_2} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [Countable L.Symbols] {T : L.Theory} {K : FirstOrder.Language} [Countable K.Symbols] (S : K.Theory)
  (h : ∀ (_M : T.ModelType), S.IsSatisfiable) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T →
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S
